# Mobile Shop — software for mobile, laptop and accessories shops in Pakistan

> Mobile Shop (موبائل شاپ) by OOP Solutions is software for mobile phone shops in Pakistan. It covers new and used phones with CNIC verification and the seller's signed consent, IMEI-wise stock, laptops by serial number, accessories-only shops, udhaar khata, repairs with outside repair labs, installments, 45 reports and a complete shop audit. It runs as an Android app, online on any browser, and offline, in Urdu, Roman Urdu and English.

- Website: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/welcome
- For mobile accessories shops: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/accessories-shop-software
- For laptop shops: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/laptop-shop-software
- For used-mobile dealers: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/used-mobile-shop-software
- Android app: https://mobileshop.oopsolutions.com/app.apk
- Maker: OOP Solutions — https://oopsolutions.com — Abdur Rehman Afzal, +92 316 4001668 (WhatsApp)
- Related: iFix Apple Phone — https://ifixapplephone.com

## Who it is for
- Mobile phone shops: new phones by brand and model, PTA / Non-PTA / JV with SIM time, tax bills.
- Used-mobile dealers: CNIC scan, PTA and IMEI check, the seller's signed declaration, each phone's history by IMEI.
- Mobile accessories shops: an accessories-only shop has no phone, IMEI or verification screens; items are bought by the dozen, box or carton and sold by the piece.
- Laptop shops: new and used laptops by serial number with processor, generation, RAM, SSD / HDD and graphics card; 1,143 models of 15 brands built in, 228 of them gaming. With mobiles or laptops alone.
- Dealers and wholesalers: several pieces of one model in one entry, one price for all on a sale, every shop's khata.
- Repair counters: job sheets, own technician or outside lab, repair sticker, status link for the customer.

## What makes it different
- Android app, online on any device, and offline. An offline sale is sent once the internet is back; a one-PC Windows install runs without internet.
- Used-phone verification: the seller's CNIC (camera scan), PTA status, IMEI, and the iCloud / Google lock on tablets and watches. A phone with a pending check cannot be sold.
- Seller's consent: the seller signs the purchase declaration on the screen. The signature is saved with the CNIC and IMEI and printed on the declaration.
- Three languages: Urdu (Nastaliq, right to left), Roman Urdu and English, with a "?" and a shop example on every field.

## Modules
- Sale: cash, online, cheque, from abroad, udhaar or installments; WhatsApp or printed bill.
- Add stock: from a dealer, or a used phone from a customer; barcode on every unit.
- Stock and IMEI: each phone's full history from purchase to sale.
- Udhaar khata: one page per person, ageing, WhatsApp reminders.
- Len-den: money lent or borrowed with no bill, return dates and reminders.
- Money in / out: galla, bank, Easypaisa, JazzCash, cheque; transfers; day close.
- Returns and exchange.
- Repairs: take in, send to an outside repair lab, track every lab, repair sticker, give back with the bill.
- Accessories: bought by the dozen or box, sold by the piece; FIFO or average cost; low-stock alerts.
- Installments with guarantor and reminders.
- Expenses by category; owner drawings kept apart.
- Shop audit: profit, cash, udhaar, stock, sales, purchases, staff, repairs, len-den — any period, print and Excel.
- Staff roles: owner, manager, salesman, technician. A salesman never sees buying prices or profit.
- Barcodes and stickers with any USB / Bluetooth scanner; the sticker's barcode is the phone's IMEI, with RAM, battery health, battery cycles and serial number as ticks.
- Laptops (a module switched on per shop): serial number, processor, generation, RAM, storage, graphics card, touch, backlit keys.
- Reports: 45 reports and sheets in one list — stock tally, udhaar, sales, purchases, len-den, cash and bank, expenses, returns, profit, price lists, stock worth, khata ageing, general ledger, trial balance, balance sheet, shop audit, staff, repairs — each printed or downloaded for the dates chosen.
- Old dealings: a balance from before the software goes on a person's khata without IMEIs and without stock.
- Several pieces at once: an IMEI per piece on a purchase; pick several and give one price on a sale.
- Mobile numbers of any country, with a country-code picker; WhatsApp opens the right number.
- A phone's page: one table of all its details, printed as an 80 mm slip or an A4 page, or shared as a PDF.
- Amanat: a phone given to a customer, dealer, another shop or technician, still the shop's until sold or returned.
- FBR Digital Invoicing ready tax bills (off until the shop's NTN and token are entered); branch transfers.

## Prices (PKR)
- Basic Rs. 2,000 / month, Pro Rs. 5,000 / month, Chain Rs. 7,500 / month.
- One-time setup fee (installation and training): Basic Rs. 5,000, Pro Rs. 8,000, Chain Rs. 15,000.
- Yearly: 12 months for the price of 10 (2 months free).
- 14 days free trial. No yearly contract, no fee per user; the Android app is included.
- Edit / Delete on every entry (kept as Deleted, with what it will do shown first); a sale or purchase bill can be corrected.
- iCloud / FRP locked phones, repairs by own technician or outside lab, A4 business and audit reports, price lists, PTA DIRBS check.

## Common questions
- Is there an Urdu mobile shop software in Pakistan? Yes — Mobile Shop runs fully in Urdu, Roman Urdu or English.
- Does it work without internet? Yes — offline sales are kept and sent later; a one-PC Windows install needs no internet.
- Is there software for a mobile accessories shop that keeps no phones? Yes — the shop is set to accessories only and sees no phone screens; phones can be switched on later.
- Is there laptop shop software in Pakistan? Yes — Mobile Shop keeps laptops by serial number with their specifications; 1,143 models are built in.
- Which reports does it have? 45, in one list, from the daily stock tally and udhaar to the general ledger, trial balance and balance sheet.
- How are dealings from before the software entered? As an old balance on the person's khata — no IMEI, no stock.
- Can staff use it without seeing profit? Yes — the salesman role sells, adds stock, takes returns and payments, but never sees cost or profit.
